methodology: Primary authority only: statute/regulation, government/tax authority, administering film agency/fund, official current guidelines/forms. No implementation changes. Where authority is silent, expenditure is not excluded; however no economic value is created without authority establishing a current producer benefit.
qpe_governing_rule: INCLUDE unless authoritative program authority explicitly excludes, limits, apportions or otherwise makes the expenditure ineligible. Payer/SPV identity alone never substitutes for the program’s vendor, residence, performance, use/consumption, incurrence or payment predicate.

ca_ab_fttc.starting_issue: Current statute/regulation, tax-authority guidance, administering film-agency manual and official QPE/cultural-test materials.

authoritative_rule_set.canonical_identity: Alberta Film and Television Tax Credit.
authoritative_rule_set.economics: Refundable credit at 22% or 30% of eligible Alberta production costs. Base gates include Alberta production activity plus either at least 60% of total production costs as eligible Alberta costs or at least 70% of total eligible salary/wages as Alberta-resident labour. The 30% tier adds specified ownership/producer or rural/remote conditions.
authoritative_rule_set.eligibility_and_timing: Minimum total production cost CAD 499,999; application no later than 120 days after Alberta principal photography begins; authorization and completion/certification deadlines apply.
authoritative_rule_set.qpe_and_territoriality: Eligible Alberta costs follow the official program; actual Alberta labour, services and goods tests govern, not payer identity alone.
authoritative_rule_set.monetization_and_stacking: Refundable corporate tax credit after certification.

ca_ab_fttc.effective_date: Alberta rules including amendments effective 2024-06-07; current 2026
ca_ab_fttc.optimizer_consequence: Implement the 22/30 tiers and their distinct statutory gates; do not use a single rate.

authoritative_rule_set.canonical_identity: Manitoba Film and Video Production Tax Credit.
authoritative_rule_set.economics: Refundable corporate credit; producer irrevocably elects either cost-of-salaries (base plus authorized bonuses, up to 65% of eligible Manitoba salaries) or cost-of-production (up to 38% of eligible Manitoba expenditures).
authoritative_rule_set.eligibility_and_timing: Eligible Manitoba production corporation and certification requirements apply; election cannot be changed for the production.
authoritative_rule_set.qpe_and_territoriality: Salary stream is Manitoba-resident labour; limited nonresident salary may be deemed eligible only under trainee ratios (30% with two trainees per nonresident, or 10% with one). Cost stream uses eligible Manitoba expenditures under the Act.
authoritative_rule_set.monetization_and_stacking: Refundable tax credit; no double claim between elected streams.

ca_mb_fvptc.effective_date: Manitoba Income Tax Act current through 2026-06-30
ca_mb_fvptc.optimizer_consequence: Represent the irrevocable alternative streams, resident/deemed-labour rules and bonuses separately.
